thread:
Nadia: Heads-up — multiple panelists on mobile couldn't submit full scorecards after yesterday's onsite. 'Culture fit' rubric missing so submit fails.
Priya: Only mobile? web ok?
Devon: Web submissions look fine. Failures coming from iOS app v2.4.1 and android v2.3.9 in APAC.
ops-bot: Detected 8 failed submissions (error: missing_field:culture_fit) between 2024-08-12T09:10:00Z and 2024-08-12T09:40:00Z.
Nadia: Repro steps: open app -> Interviews -> open candidate -> Scorecard -> tap submit. Form shows 3 fields instead of usual 6.
Luke: Looks like compact_scorecard feature flag recently enabled for mobile to reduce vertical space. Might have filtered out fields marked as "non-essential" — and a mapping bug classified culture_fit as non-essential.
Devon: I captured the console trace from local repro: `bridge.js: showCompact() -> filterFields() -> removeByTag('display_small')`
Priya: Quick mitigation: disable compact_scorecard for mobile in flags service and force a schema refresh. Can we do that?
Luke: I'm on it. Rolling flag back for mobile iOS and Android in APAC first. ETA 15m.
recruiter-bot: Flag rollback scheduled: compact_scorecard -> mobile -> region: APAC -> initiated by Luke.
ops-bot: Flag rollback completed. Resending any pending scorecard prompts to panelists who failed to submit.
Devon: After rollback, mobile form shows full 6 fields in repro. Patch to mapping landed in branch `fix/scorecard-tagging` and will be merged today.
Nadia: :pray: Great. We should also add a quick note to interviewer training: if using mobile, update app and verify all rubric fields visible before the debrief.
Priya: I'll update the training checklist and ping interviewer slack with short PSA.
Luke: Patch merged to main and will be part of next mobile release. Opening a short incident note and linking to this thread.
Devon: I'll follow up with the 3 affected candidates to confirm we received the delayed feedback.
Nadia: Thanks all — good cross-team response.
Priya: Action items: training doc + checklist update, postmortem stub, follow-ups to candidates.
Devon: Adding labels: sev-low, mobile, scorecard, follow-up.
